name: commons-dj-nogate
description: A two-deck DJ app for your own music and Creative Commons tracks, with yt-dlp built in.

scripts.package:win-arm64: node scripts/fetch-ytdlp.mjs win32 arm64 && node scripts/vendor-ort.mjs win32 arm64 && electron-packager . "Commons DJ NoGate" --platform=win32 --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=assets/icon.ico --extra-resource=vendor/win32-arm64/bin --extra-resource=vendor/win32-arm64/ort --ignore="^/(dist|out|vendor|test|scripts|node_modules)($|/)" --prune=false
scripts.package:win-x64: node scripts/fetch-ytdlp.mjs win32 x64 && node scripts/vendor-ort.mjs win32 x64 && electron-packager . "Commons DJ NoGate" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=assets/icon.ico --extra-resource=vendor/win32-x64/bin --extra-resource=vendor/win32-x64/ort --ignore="^/(dist|out|vendor|test|scripts|node_modules)($|/)" --prune=false
